title: BHP Billiton Mitsubishi Alliance (BMA) - proposed acquisition of New Saraji Metallurgical Coal Project

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: BHP Billiton Mitsubishi Alliance (BMA) proposes to acquire the New Saraji Metallurgical Coal Project (New Saraji) from New Hope Corporation Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of markets for the production and supply of metallurgical coal. The ACCC did not consider it necessary to form a definitive view on market definition since the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in either a broad or a narrow market.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition since: * there will be no overlap with the existing metallurgical coal production of BMA since New Saraji is not currently producing any volumes of metallurgical coal for export or sale; and * there will continue to be significant Australian and international alternative suppliers of metallurgical coal with substantial existing metallurgical coal resources to constrain the merged entity.
